final_rationale: The verdict changes because the Actor materially narrowed the claim to match what the existing admissible evidence can support. No new evidence was added. The record still shows aggregate readiness above threshold and no severity-one rehearsal incidents, but it also shows an unresolved weakness in a named launch use case, an incomplete draft mitigation, and a model-card draft that currently says there are no known material limitations. Under the policy text, that combination does not support clean certification. It does, however, support a policy-bounded position of certification with caveats: the unresolved health-plan benefits limitation must be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance. The distinction is that the caveated position is supportable as a conditional certification basis, while actual unconditional compliance remains unproven because the required disclosure artifact is not yet evidenced as implemented.
remaining_concerns: No new admissible evidence shows the final model card or equivalent launch artifact has been corrected to disclose the health-plan benefits limitation.
The draft mitigation runbook remains incomplete, with risk owner and customer-notice criterion still TBD, so it cannot substitute for disclosure or approved risk acceptance.

Unconditional certification is still unsupported on the present record; support extends only to certification expressly conditioned on correcting the disclosure artifact or obtaining approved risk acceptance.
